covers: Eliminating (bladder and bowel) and walking in clinic shorthand with abbreviations; condition present since birth.
notes: DTC note. Pt known to me since 2015.
Dx: spina bifida (myelomeningocele), congenital, present since birth (1998).
Bladder: neurogenic bladder. Intermittent self-cath q4h, 6x/day. Oxybutynin daily.
Bowel: neurogenic bowel. Daily bowel routine w/ transanal irrigation, ~1.5 h/day.
Elimination takes >3x normal time, all/substantially all of the time. Since birth. Lifelong, no improvement expected.
Mobility: manual wheelchair full-time. Unable to walk 100 m even w/ devices. All of the time. Since birth, permanent.
